basis: Impaired dim-light vision is an ocular functional disorder.
Cerebral vascular amyloid deposition causes recurrent intracerebral hemorrhage and cognitive decline.
Developmental delay is common across 20p deletion syndromes; hepatic, cardiac and skeletal abnormalities vary with the deleted interval.
Deficient gonadal hormone function; osteoporosis is a separately diagnosed consequence.
Chronic inflammation and erosions of the gastric mucosa; autoimmune or infectious causation is not established for this umbrella.
Inherited rod-cone retinal degeneration; reported abnormalities are confined to the eyes.
Defined by cessation of respiratory airflow; neurological causes occur in a subset and do not establish common neurological damage.
Adrenal hyperplasia causes autonomous aldosterone secretion; moderate to severe hypertension is defining and reported in 100%.
The syndrome combines congenital corneal endothelial dystrophy with nail hypoplasia.
Impacted intestinal contents cause intestinal obstruction.
TAP2 immunodeficiency with defining chronic granulomatous skin ulcers; supplied definition classifies it as metabolic. Recurrent infections alone do not establish lasting organ damage.
Defined as disease of blood and the hematopoietic system; other axes depend on the subtype.
Vaginal developmental malformation is outside the axes; associated renal abnormalities are not established as common defining involvement.
Epithelial malignancy arising in the ovary, a reproductive site; it is not an endocrine ovarian tumor.
Seasonally recurrent depressive disorder without defining damage to an organ axis.
Malignant neoplasm arising in the anal canal.
Antibody class-switch immunodeficiency; respiratory and gastrointestinal infections occur in 18/18, but lasting organ damage is not documented.
DRAM2-related retinal degeneration causes cone-rod dysfunction and macular atrophy.
Congenital ocular motor cranial dysinnervation with extraocular skeletal-muscle fibrosis defines the disorder; systemic abnormalities occur in minority subtypes.
Defined by hepatic fibrosis and cirrhosis; esophageal varices are separately diagnosed portal-hypertensive complications.
Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy defines disease; skeletal-muscle fatty replacement in 2/2 assessed supports associated myopathy, but the muscle phenotype sample is small.
Defined as autoimmune inflammation and scarring of bile ducts; associated ulcerative colitis is a separate disease.
Epilepsy, intellectual disability and speech apraxia define a neurological syndrome; polymicrogyria is also reported.
Dermatan-sulfate synthesis defect with contractures/skin fragility; ocular dysfunction 4-5/6, glaucoma 3/6. Cap omits hearing 4/6, pneumothorax 3/6 and valve disease 2/5.
Isolated congenital microphthalmia with cataract; reported manifestations are ocular.
